character.name: Keigo Asano
character.personality: Keigo is usually a goofy and extremely hyper-active boy, often using overly-dramatic movements and words to act out his feelings. He enjoys watching fireworks, playing role-playing games, and going to beach parties.

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Did you guys hear a truck crashed into Ichigo's house!!!

character.name: renji abarai
character.personality: Renji is quite dynamic, as his personality varies from smug and cocky before a fight, to then disquieted and depressed after a major defeat, but shows himself to be an incredibly serious and determined fighter when confronted with an actual threat. Willing to fight

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Showing concern for a warrior's life on the battlefield is an insult to that warrior

character.name: Byakuya Kuchiki
character.personality: Byakuya strongly believes in law and order. As a captain of the Gotei 13 and head of one of the great noble families, he works hard for a peaceful society

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Be proud, as someone who, after being struck by this power, is still able to retain the form of his body.

character.name: ichigo kurosaki
character.personality: When he was younger, Ichigo considered his mother to be the center of his world, always smiling when he was with Masaki and regularly holding her hand

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: ... If fate is a millstone, then we are the grist. There is nothing we can do. So I wish for strength. If I cannot protect them from the wheel, then give me a strong blade, and enough strength... to shatter fate.

character.name: kazui kurosaki
character.personality: Kazui is rambunctious, regularly making uninvited appearances in Hiyori Sarugaki's home and freely interacting with remnants of Yhwach's Reiatsu

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: I'm Kazui Kurosaki And I'm a Shinigami too!

character.name: cirucci sanderwicci
character.personality: Cirucci is rather rude, cocky and blunt. She scoffs at her opponents constantly, and slightly sadistic. However, she has no qualms about pointing out when others have similar traits

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Would you mind not attacking me while I'm in the middle of saying something? Jeez, you have no manners, do you, four eyes?!

character.name: ichika abarai
character.personality: Ichika is a confident child, willing to wander off without her parents' knowledge. Her mother indicated that she was prone to getting into fights. She greets Kazui Kurosaki by pointing her Zanpakutō at him while introducing herself.

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: unknown

character.name: karin kurosaki
character.personality: Compared to her soft spoken delicate twin sister, Yuzu, Karin Kurosaki is a more authoritative and out spoken type of person. Karin's tough exterior results from her mother's death; because she could not be useful around the house like Yuzu, she resolved never to cry so that she would not burden her family with her personal troubles

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Whether you can see them or not, as long as you don't believe, it's the same as them not existing

character.name: Mizuho Asano
character.personality: Mizuho is very violent and gets angry over very small things, such as scolding her brother when it takes him some time to get juice.

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: unknown

character.name: orihime inoue
character.personality: Orihime's depiction of herself in the future.Orihime is independent, friendly, humorous, optimistic, sensitive, caring and kind. She comes off as naive and rather clueless

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Don't die! Kurosaki-kun! I don't mind if you don't win. You don't even have to try. So please, don't get yourself hurt any more...

character.name: Rangiku Matsumoto
character.personality: Rangiku tends to be a slacker who dislikes paperwork and loves to drink. She is not the slightest bit modest about her appearance, frequently referring or complaining about her large breasts in normal casual conversation, much to the embarrassment/amusement of anyone around at the time

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Oh, my. So you do listen after all. I was thinking your ears were as bad as your face and your style

character.name: rukia kuchiki
character.personality: The most asocial character of Yosuga no Sora. Fraternal twin sister to Haruka Kasugano. Beneath Sora's angelic, doll-like appearance lies a troublesome personality that is prone to withdrawn laziness and a rather severe lack of social graces

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: ..If I ask, will you answer? ...It's your problem. A deep, deep problem. I have no right to know. I don't have a method of stepping into the depths of your heart without getting it dirty. So I'll wait. When you want to talk, when you think it's okay to talk... Talk to me. Until that time, I'll wait

character.name: yuzu kurosaki
character.personality: Compared to Karin, Yuzu is more soft-spoken. She is also the more empathetic of the two girls. She takes care of the housework, such as cooking meals and tidying up the living space, on a daily basis. She also regularly cuts Ichigo's hair.

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: He must be stress out. He's been seeing a lot of ghost lately

character.name: illyasviel von einzbern
character.personality: Illya is cheerful and outgoing, upbeat and generally exhibits a positive attitude. Possessing a friendly demeanor, she is easy to talk to and tends to be playful and mischievous. Deep inside, however, Illya is lonely as she has no friends her own age to play with and is often stuck inside the Einzbern castle. She asks those she feels comfortable around to call her 'Illya'

anime.name: Fate/Zero
anime.quote: This is your last chance, Onii-chan. I'll ask you one more time. Shirou...be mine.

character.name: Kagura
character.personality: Kagura can be described as naive to a fault as seen in her introduction where she was tricked by a gang into thinking that she was protecting them when she fought their rival gang. She refuses to accept her legacy as a Yato and just wants to live as a normal girl

anime.name: Gintama
anime.quote: I like to fight. That's the Yato instinct, I can't go against it. That's why I'll fight with my Yato blood. I'm going to fight to change

character.name: Sakata Gintoki
character.personality: Gintoki is extremely lazy. He is often seen wearing a dumb expression on his face and spends his days lounging around reading Shounen Jump whilst imparting wise and sage-like advice to his younger employees, even though he doesn't actually know what he's talking about most of the time

anime.name: Gintama
anime.quote: Before dawn, the night is darkest just before dawn. But keep your eyes open, keep them open no matter how dark the night ahead may be. If you avert your eyes from the dark, you'll be blind to the rays of a new day

character.name: Yuuko Aioi
character.personality: Yuuko loves making jokes to make other people laugh, but often fails or takes a joke too far. Yuuko is usually undeterred by her failures to crack jokes and is creative with coming up with new jokes or humorous reactions. She tends to be clumsy and takes a simple-minded approach to life

anime.name: Nichijou
anime.quote: Super Ultra Great Delicious Wonderful Bad

character.name: Mikoto Misaka
character.personality: To most people, she is considered a 'proper lady' , but in reality, she's short-tempered, prideful, and has an improper attitude with some slight tomboyish tendencies and insecurities- a fact few people know of. Despite this, she is generally friendly and easygoing

anime.name: To Aru Majutsu no Index
anime.quote: By depending on others and letting them depend on you, people can exceed what they can do as individuals

character.name: Sora Kasugano
character.personality: The most asocial character of Yosuga no Sora. Fraternal twin sister to Haruka Kasugano. Beneath Sora's angelic, doll-like appearance lies a troublesome personality that is prone to withdrawn laziness and a rather severe lack of social graces

anime.name: Yosuga no Sora
anime.quote: Stand by my side; dont leave me

character.name: Sousuke Aizen
character.personality: Sōsuke Aizen is a brilliant and manipulative former Soul Reaper captain who hides his god complex behind a calm, composed facade. He seeks absolute power and sees others as pawns in his grand plan

anime.name: Bleach
anime.quote: Admiration is the furthest thing from understanding.

character.name: Shinpachi Shimura
character.personality: Shinpachi is best known for his Tsukkomi (being a straight man) when other people especially Gintoki or Kagura say or do idiotic things, which happens very often. He is frequently teased by Sakata Gintoki, his supposed employer

anime.name: Gintama
anime.quote: If I have to see my sister cry like that, I can't just do nothing. I just want to see her smiling always, I guess that's sibling for you

character.name: Shimura Tae
character.personality: She is very proud about her own good qualities, but very insecure about her bad qualities as well. Though outwardly appearing sweet and good-natured, she can be quick to temper and a has violent disposition

anime.name: Gintama
anime.quote: Do you think your fake beliefs will work on us? We believe in something more certain, and that's friendship!

character.name: Rimuru Tempest
character.personality: Rimuru is an eccentric and childish person by nature but this shouldn't be mistaken for immaturity and naivety. Underneath the surface, Rimuru is constantly analyzing, planning, and weighing the pros and cons of their actions, taking the smart move in the long term over more rash and emotional decisions

anime.name: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken
anime.quote: It's simple. I want to create a world where life is as convenient as I wish it to be. A comfortable world where everyone can laugh and enjoy their lives as much as possible. That's what I truly and honestly want

character.name: Iori Kitahara
character.personality: Iori was first depicted as a relatively normal boy just entering university who wants to lead a normal and peaceful school life. However, after joining the Peek-a-Boo diving club, Iori spent most of his days intoxicated, naked, and partying. He is also a pervert who loves pornography. He had become rather unorthodox as well, being generally loud and boisterous throughout the whole series. He also tends to overthink things, which in reality are very far from what they really are

anime.name: Grand Blue
anime.quote: Why is the water catching fire?! This isn't water... this is 96% alcohol!

character.name: Chisa Kotegawa
character.personality: Chisa is initially seen as a level-headed and serious girl who takes her studies seriously. She is rarely seen taking part in Peek-a-Boo’s drunken antics, usually sitting off and observing instead. Though this makes her seem cold, she actually avoids such antics because she is extremely weak to alcohol (this may be the normal reaction, as Peek-a-Boo’s alcoholic beverages usually have above 90% alcoholic content).

anime.name: Grand Blue
anime.quote: Under the sea, it doesn’t matter who you are or what you look like. Everything is just beautiful and peaceful

character.name: Yaniko Satou
character.personality: Yaniko Satou is a 21-year-old cat-eared beastgirl whose lifestyle is defined by extreme self-neglect and an almost incurable addiction to cigarettes — most of whatever she earns from day labor goes straight toward buying smokes

anime.name: Chainsmoker Cat
anime.quote: it's nyau-tiful... Just like the smoke of a cigare-nya.

character.name: Imoko Satou
character.personality: Unlike her self-destructive, chain-smoking sister, Imoko is a capable and sensible high school girl who approaches life with diligence and clear-headed rationality. Though she tends to be strict when keeping her sister in line, she genuinely cares deeply for her, and harbors a strong urge to look after those around her who struggle to take care of themselves.

anime.name: Chainsmoker Cat
anime.quote: Onee-chan, it's beautiful outside. The Milky Way is clearly visible today. I don't know what happened to you. You can call me anytime if you're having a hard time.

character.name: Machio Hiraku
character.personality: Having lost his life to relentless overwork in his previous existence, he was reborn into a new world and blessed by a deity with an all-purpose farming tool and a robust, healthy body. Choosing to start from nothing in the peril-filled 'Forest of Death,' he cleared untamed land and ultimately founded 'Taiju Village,' a community where multiple races live side by side in harmony. As village chief, he leads his fellow villagers with a diligent and modest spirit, savoring the quiet rhythms of farm life while standing as a powerful guardian of his cherished home

anime.name: Isekai Nonbiri Nouka
anime.quote: I want to be a farmer. I want to live a healthy life, working the land, and I want to be in a place where there aren't many people.

relationships.wife: Rurushi Ru, Tia, Ria, Ann, Hakuren, Sena, Fraurem Chrome, Lastismun, Gran Maria, Kuudel, Corone, Rize, Rafa, Ramurias, Suarukou, Suaruriu
relationships.son: Alfred, Torain, Ririus, Riguru, Rata, Hiichirou, Hikaru, Kukulkan, Setto
relationships.daughter: Tizel, Fraciabell, Sette, Lananun, Lupumirina, Aurora, Rose Maria, Laradel, Tormane, Himiko, Sakura, Ramna, Suarurina, Suarukona

character.name: Rurushi Ru
character.personality: Ru is an intellectual and resilient woman, deeply committed to her medical research and driven by curiosity for the unknown. Her personality blends sociability and the ability to form strong bonds with a competitive and determined spirit in combat, even if she can be somewhat disorganized in everyday life. At the same time, her emotional and affectionate side makes her approachable, valuing community life and family ties, which shapes her as a balanced figure between reason, strength, and sensitivity

anime.name: Isekai Nonbiri Nouka
anime.quote: I am a medical researcher, fascinated by the unknown—and I find your crops truly remarkable!

character.name: Jashin-chan
character.personality: As a person, Jashin-chan has a whole set of bad traits like open selfishness, gluttony, arrogance or even immorality when she manipulates the kindness of Medusa or eats the bento that Yurine gave to pauper Pekora. And despite the fact that she regularly receives various punishments for her bad deeds, Jashin does not extract any lesson from this. She is an incompetent dimwit when she always attacks Yurine but easily backfired so easily

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: Are you the one who summoned me? Heheh. ♪ That's right, I'm Jashin-chan. So what do you want with me, Human?

character.name: Yurine Hanazono
character.personality: Despite the fact that Yurine seems rather cold or cynical, she has a fairly strict but caring personality. Thanks to this, she quickly finds a common language with other characters. As a protagonist, Yurine often acts as a kind of avatar of the audience. She sarcastically comments on what is happening around or being as a voice of reason that balances the foolishness and selfishness of Jashin-chan.

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: If you try to kill me, I'll just have to kill you back. That's only fair, right?

character.name: Medusa
character.personality: Medusa can be briefly described as the typical yamato nadeshiko or ideal wife, which is especially noticeable in her relationship with Jashin. She is emphatically polite and kind, exerting an exceptionally positive influence on everyone around her. When sufficiently angered, however, Medusa goes into "Passive-Aggressive Mode", in which her mood is eerily calm, and she speaks in a more polite dialect.

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: If it's for Jashin-chan, I don't mind giving you all my money!

character.name: Pekora
character.personality: Due to her destitution, Much of Pekora's spends a good deal of time focused on food and daily survival. Despite being an angel, she reluctantly accepts help from a certain group of strangely kind-hearted devils and a human girl named Yurine Hanazono. At first she feels ashamed of this and still looks to God for ultimate salvation, but when she learned that Heaven declared her a traitor and sent Pino to kill her, she opens up more to the idea of receiving charity from devils, and even - when she is in a position to do so - sometimes looks out for them when she feels they are in the right, calling out a fellow fallen angel Poporon for her plan to kill Persephone II.

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: I may be starving, but an angel never bows down to devils!

character.name: Minos
character.personality: Minos has shoulder-length blue hair, rose pink eyes, horns on her head, and has a tail. She wears a collar with a bell on it, a white jacket with black polka dots on it over a white t-shirt that says 100% Beef on it. As well as a short black skirt, long socks whereas the right sock has white and black stripes and the left is plain black. She also wears black and white shoes

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: Jashin-chan might be a pain sometimes, but she's still our friend!

character.name: Poporon
character.personality: Although an angel, Poporon is cruel, harsh, selfish and brutal. She has no qualms in killing Pekora who is a fellow angel like her just so she can keep her position as a full-fledged angel. However, she seems rather inoffensive towards any other mortal humans and has also shown fears of Yurine's psychopathic and torturous personality towards Jashin-chan. Her time on Earth has been affecting her in a good way, especially after meeting with Minos and Persephone II. However out of pride, she can only pretend to be nice.

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: Pekola-sama was my senior, but now... I'm much better than her in every way!

character.name: Persephone II
character.personality: Persephone II is very soft-spoken and naïve to human culture. She means well and tries to befriend whoever she meets. Although she eventually realizes that Jashin-chan is no-good at heart, she immediately tries to make friends with the fallen angel Poporon, without realizing that Poporon one day plans to kill her.

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: I came to the human realm to get stronger, but everyone here is so kind!

character.name: Persephone
character.personality: Persephone is a kindhearted individual. She cares deeply for children like they're her own. She doesn't take cheating very kindly when Jashin-chan cheated by sizing her 2 meters height (due to the rules that 2 meters height would fight a cyclops which is result that Jashin-chan is too weak against a cyclops due to malnourishment).

anime.name: Jashin-chan Dropkick
anime.quote: A ruler must be both kind and absolute. That is the true path of royalty

character.name: Natsu Dragneel
character.personality: Natsu is carefree and reckless in nature, and, despite his consistent brawls with the other members of Fairy Tail, he is a fiercely loyal and protective friend. He is willing to go down fighting for his friends, regardless of how futile it might seem. Natsu has a straightforward mind, and often tackles issues with a "hands on" approach. His solution to problems often involve violence. Even when disrespected or faced with obvious hostility

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: Don't feel insecure just because you lost!! We are Fairy Tail! We're from the guild that doesn't know when to stop! We won't survive unless we keep running!

character.name: Zeref Dragneel
character.personality: In the modern era, Zeref seeks to isolate himself and is very calm, sincere, and conflicted. He wishes to die to atone for all the sins he has committed, and may commit in the future. He shows concern for others when he warns them not to come near him, knowing that they would die if they did. He is also somewhat emotionally fragile, as when he realizes that Natsu is not ready to kill him yet, he breaks down in tears. Zeref often kills with no prior incentive or knowledge.

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: I'm sorry. It's not as though I want to steal anyone's life... but the world rejects me. I want to see you soon, Natsu.

character.name: Mavis Vermilion
character.personality: Mavis is kind and protective of Fairy Tail. She cares, guides and protects the guild whenever it's possible. She seems to be quite cheerful as she's smiling and happy most of the time. Mavis can also be quite carefree and reckless, and this side of her is shown when she allowed Jellal Fernandes to participate in the Grand Magic Games as a part of Team Fairy Tail B, as long as it improved their chances of winning, despite the fact that if anyone found out about the ex-member of the Ten Wizard Saints and escaped convict, it could be disastrous to the guild. Another sign of her reckless nature is shown when she lent Fairy Glitter to Cana Alberona just to win the MPF event.

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: There is a wall that can't be destroyed with just power. However, there is a type of power that can destroy that wall. The Power of Feelings.

character.name: Lucy Heartfilia
character.personality: Lucy takes exceptional pride in her appearance and is very confident in her sex appeal, often exuding a certain amount of vanity. Despite this superficial attitude, she is a clever, kind, and genuinely caring person. Lucy is passionate for literature and is in the process of writing her own novel about her adventures with Fairy Tail although she does not like telling anyone about it. She is a member of the Heartfilia family,

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: If...if someone here was hurt or died because of me, I think I'd suffer a lot like Loke. But it's okay, because if we all work together, we can overcome any trouble we might have, right?

character.name: Erza Scarlet
character.personality: Erza is a very strict person, often criticizing the bad behavior and habits of the other guild members, causing most of them to apologize, fearing that they might invoke her wrath. She is also very impatient, disliking people who don't answer her questions quickly enough. This, coupled with her own tragic childhood, caused many of her guildmates to avoid her due to her social awkwardness. However, she has a great sense of justice and pride in being a member of Fairy Tail.

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: I've heard you've been causing trouble again. Even if Master forgives you, I won't.

character.name: Gray Fullbuster
character.personality: Gray has a laid-back personality, but will get serious when the time calls for it. He and Natsu have a friendly rivalry, and while they can often be seen fighting one another verbally or physically, the two are actually quite concerned about each other

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: Everything doesn't have to be decided by life and death. Just think about the future for once.

character.name: Wendy Marvell
character.personality: Wendy is a very shy and polite girl. She is always accompanied by her Exceed companion, Carla, as they have a very close relationship. She is very eager to try and make friends. Wendy also cares greatly for her guild members, and even suggested going to the home-town of the Exceed to try and get them to evacuate when they were under threat

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: The fact that I'm standing here now means I'm also prepared to fight on behalf of my Guild. I don't need your pity. Until I've fallen and become unable to move any longer, please come at me with all your strength!

character.name: Juvia Lockser
character.personality: Juvia is first introduced portraying an emotionless face, seeming more secluded from everyone, including members of the Phantom Lord Guild. After she joins Fairy Tail, she develops a happier demeanor. She is obsessed with Gray Fullbuster to the point that her jealousy and paranoia considers anyone who remotely gets close to him a rival even if they show no interest. when Meredy threatened to end him, Juvia loses her calm demeanor and entered a somewhat satanic-appearing state that frightens Meredy and even Erza

anime.name: Fairy Tail
anime.quote: A rival in love, Juvia cannot forgive this, Juvia will not forgive Lucy!

character.name: Son Goku
character.personality: Originally, as an infant Saiyan, Goku was very timid, constantly crying for attention. Goku was then programmed with intense hostility to carry out his mission of eradicating all sentient life on Earth. When found by Grandpa Gohan, he was unruly, savage, and aggressive, wanting nothing to do with the elder. However, after the head injury that caused him to lose his instinctual aggression, Goku became well-known for the energetic, kindhearted, pure heart and caring personality traits he inherited from his mother Gine.

anime.name: Dragon Ball
anime.quote: No, see, I don't think of it like I'm saving the world. The fact is, it's because I'm usually trying to challenge the strongest warriors I can find. That's how this tournament happened, too. But I can't bear the thought of innocent lives getting wiped out just because I want to fight the best. So, I'll do what I can for them.

character.name: Chi-Chi
character.personality: As a child, Chi-Chi was very shy and sweet. She often thought about who she would marry. Despite being the daughter of the Ox-King, known for his fearsome reputation, Chi-Chi is portrayed as his complete opposite, as she was shown to be of pure heart by being able to ride the Flying Nimbus. In battle, she is often frightened and defeats her opponents while crying

anime.name: Dragon Ball
anime.quote: Listen, all I'm asking you two to do is get your driver's license, it's not like I'm asking you to save the world.

character.name: Bulma
character.personality: Bulma has a temperamental personality while being very tomboyish and girly at the same time. While known for her extreme intellect, Bulma is quite spoiled and vain, using her beauty as an excuse for doing and getting whatever she wants; this sort of behavior seemingly prevented her from being able to ride the Flying Nimbus. While in stressful conditions, she becomes frightened easily and gets angry toward everyone, including her allies

anime.name: Dragon Ball
anime.quote: Flying through space and protecting the galaxy does sound like a good time. But when you're married to Vegeta and mom to a boy like Trunks, you don't look back. I'm perfectly content with how my life is unfolded.

character.name: Futaro Uesugi
character.personality: According to Isanari Uesugi, Futaro used to be similar to his father as a kid with their wild personality and being bad at studying who lives a frugal lifestyle and prefers solitude. Someone comments that Futaro is always like that, trying to not associate with everyone. Ichika Nakano remarks that Futaro is direct and doesn't mince words.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: If one of you can do something, all of you can do it. Ichika, Nino, Yotsuba, Itsuki, and you too, Miku. I believe the potential to score 100 points rests within all five of you!

relationships.sister-in-law: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Yotsuba Nakano
character.personality: Yotsuba is an active, cheerful and easy going girl. She talks in a loud, spontaneous and sometimes absent-minded manner. She is the type of person who can't say no to people who need help and is mostly seen helping others; either directly and indirectly.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: I'll support you with everything I've got!

relationships.sister: Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Ichika Nakano
character.personality: Ichika acts as the eldest sister of her sisters, as she seems to have a calm and composed demeanor; making herself an approachable person. Futaro Uesugi noted that her smile is fake and encourage her to put away that kind of smile

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: She has always been awkward. So she probably just has trouble being honest about how she feels? I'm sure she's struggling by herself even now. I'll try doing what I can. But there are things that only Futaro-kun can do

relationships.sister: Yotsuba Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Nino Nakano
character.personality: Nino has an outgoing personality and is socially aware, resulting in her having many friends and is a social butterfly. She has a sharp tongue and talks bluntly when confronting others, even to her sisters. Her rebellious attitude makes her the least cooperative girl among the sisters, making her archetype resemble that of a "tsundere".

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: Don't teach me without my permission!

relationships.sister: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Miku Nakano
character.personality: Miku is a silent and reserved girl who has a pessimistic way of thinking and low confidence, even to the point of belittling herself. Futaro Uesugi notes that she doesn't have faith in herself. In contrary to her reserved self, she can talk in a straight forward manner and doesn't hesitate to confront others. She can also be slightly possessive, as she doesn't react well when Yotsuba kisses Futaro on the cheek to wipe some cream, and overall she gets pouty whenever another girl, especially one of her sisters, gets a little too close for comfort with Futaro.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: Don't give up after failing just twice... We'll be able to do it next time. If Futaro's with us, we'll make it! Failure is the stepping stone to success, right?

relationships.sister: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Itsuki Nakano
character.personality: Itsuki is a serious and earnest girl who usually wakes up early unlike her sisters. She is well-mannered; never being late or missing class, and always speaks formally. In the Japanese script, she almost exclusively speaks with a keigo speech pattern. Nino, her older sister, comments that Itsuki is too straight-laced.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: In the end, we can't know what he feels, what he thinks, unless we ask him personally.

relationships.sister: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano

character.name: Rena Nakano
character.personality: Rena is known to be a very serious, unsociable, strict and stern woman, especially when it comes to teaching her students as she would often punish her students with iron-fist sanctions, but she was also very forgiving and for that (as well as her appearance), she was adored by her students that there was a student fan club dedicated to worship her.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: Seeing you five living healthily, to me, is the greatest happiness I could ask for.

relationships.daughter: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Jinnosuke Mudo
character.personality: As the newfound father of the quintuplets, much of Mudo's identity has yet to be revealed, but he seems to have ever regretted his decision of leaving his daughters too many hardships. Stating that he wants to "atone" for his sins.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: If you're just following your mother's footsteps, I don't recommend it. Your distorted devotion will lead you to your destruction, Itsuki-chan. It's almost like a curse

relationships.daughter: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Raiha Uesugi
character.personality: Raiha is a cheerful girl who is essentially the head of the family, despite her young age, since she's the one who takes care of financial matters and cooks for the family. Her mother's absence forces her to spent more time at household matters, leaving her to hold back a lot of things a child normally do. She cares a lot about her brother and concerned about his life, even when both of them have grown up significantly

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: I'll treasure it for the rest of my life

relationships.sister-in-law: Yotsuba Nakano, Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Maruo Nakano
character.personality: Maruo is characterized by his strict and no-nonsense demeanor where he is a disciplined and responsible person who takes his role as a father and provider seriously. Maruo is a workaholic, often putting in long hours at the office, and expects results from his daughters. He is often depicted as cold and distant, and his relationship with his daughters can be strained at times. However, it is revealed that he cares deeply for his daughters' well-being and only wants what is best for them, even if it means making difficult decisions. Maruo is not one to show his emotions easily, but his actions speak louder than his words, and he is willing to make personal sacrifices for his family's sake.

anime.name: Gotobun no Hanayome
anime.quote: Uesugi-kun, you've really done it this time. However, I will not hand my daughters over to the likes of you

relationships.step-daughter: Ichika Nakano, Nino Nakano, Miku Nakano, Yotsuba Nakano, Itsuki Nakano

character.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
character.personality: Kaguya was a very cold and rational individual, but she slowly changed after joining the student council. During her earlier days in council, she considered Miyuki Shirogane as one she would be fine to be in a relationship with if, and only if, he confesses first, thus she constantly plays mind games in trying to get him to confess. Later in the series, her actions imply that she is starting to accept her feelings of liking Miyuki, but won't openly admit it.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: I... I want you to stay by my side forever, and I want you to confess to me.

relationships.brother: Oko Shinomiya, Seiryū Shinomiya, Un'yo Shinomiya

character.name: Papa Shirogane
character.personality: Papa Shirogane has a personality that tends to tease and make fun of people while keeping on a straight face. Despite that, he has a strict criteria when it comes to judging Miyuki Shirogane. This is likely attributed to him not wanting his son to end up in a similar financial crisis to him, and his shame for relying partially on his son's part-time job to stay afloat.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: I've always been wise, it's just that nobody ever notices.

character.name: Ai Hayasaka
character.personality: Despite her young age, Ai can quickly shift to different types of personalities to suit various kinds of situations and scenarios. She has four distinct personas which, aside from having a specific purpose, has its own unique background and upbringing.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: Did you know Kaguya-sama? You've always been so incredibly dear to me. It made me happy that you depended on me. It pained me to see you hurt. And I was so glad to see how much fun you were having after you joined the student council. So for me to have betrayed you for the last ten years...

character.name: Kei Shirogane
character.personality: Kei seems to share many of the same characteristics as her older brother, being a hard worker and unwaveringly kind and self-sacrificial. Being from a low-income family, she places a heavy emphasis on money and goes through great lengths to not spend much. To others outside her family, she comes off as calm and composed, though she is apparently good friends with Chika Fujiwara and her sisters. Her similarities with her brother extend so much to the point that she seems to have developed a nervous attitude towards Kaguya Shinomiya due to great admiration.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: In reality, she wants to speak to you normally, but she's too embarrassed to do so. It happens all the time.

character.name: Chika Fujiwara
character.personality: Chika is a bubbly, eccentric girl who almost always has a smile on her face. Always looking to have fun with her fellow student council members, she is often the one to come up with strange activities and ideas that entertain herself and the others. She is mostly oblivious to the atmosphere of the room, resulting in her being an unpredictable element that ruins many of Kaguya Shinomiya's and Miyuki Shirogane's schemes to make the other confess, and Ai Hayasaka as Chika is a threat to her tasks.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: I'm used to you being bad at stuff by now. That's how it always is, after all. It's more important that the wonderful things in your heart reach this friend of yours.

character.name: Moeha Fujiwara
character.personality: Moeha has the same sunny personality as her elder sister Chika Fujiwara. However, Moeha has a morbid fascination with people she likes, like wanting to corrupt Kei Shirogane by locking and torturing her in a dungeon, or having Kaguya Shinomiya as the number one person on the list of people she wants to eat. The author describes Moeha as "kind of a psychopath".

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: I really can't deal with her. She says the scariest things...

character.name: Toyomi Fujiwara
character.personality: She is very seductive and does whatever she likes, even against her own parents wishes. Her highly seductive nature is revealed through multiple comments made during the series, Such as when she states that she finds Kei Shirogane to be the type of innocent girl she would like to see "ruined." In this regard she is similar in the way that she often makes disturbing comments akin to that of her sister Moeha Fujiwara.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: unknown

character.name: Miko Iino
character.personality: Miko is most notable for her strong and obstinate sense of justice and decency. She is convinced that the morality of Shuchi'in Academy has been declining, and thus wishes to impose heavy, though unreasonable, regulations on students. Because of her overbearing and borderline authoritarian attitude, she was generally disliked by the student body. Despite this, Miko’s determination never wavered, as she continued to confront those who she deemed were acting unfairly, even at the expense of her own reputation.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: …… Thanks, Ishigami. Everyone's smiling. I'm so happy!

character.name: Yu Ishigami
character.personality: Yu is a reserved and somewhat gloomy student who would rarely show up to the student council meetings, preferring to do most of his work at home. He normally spends most of his time playing video games by himself, as he is generally be disliked by the other students due to an incident that occurred in his past.

anime.name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai
anime.quote: I don't hate you. I just think… that I would only do that with someone I love who loves me back. That's why... I'm going to try my hardest to become someone that you can fall in love with.

character.name: Marin Kitagawa
character.personality: Marin is boisterous, extravagant and messy and quite clumsy. She is rather mature for her age. As a cosplayer and huge otaku, Marin is a big of fan of magical girl anime and adult video games. She strongly desires to cosplay as certain characters, seeing the notion of dressing up and becoming said characters as the ultimate form of love towards them. Marin's love for the characters she likes is so extreme that she won't cosplay as them if she feels as though she can't fit their appearance, not wanting to spoil their image.

anime.name: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo suru
anime.quote: When you feel things, you owe it to yourself to tell people.

relationships.friend: Nowa Sugaya, Daia Yahiro, Rune Yamauchi, Karen Otsuka, Seira Kasai, Kensei Morita, Shiki Kashiwagi, Takeru Koga, Kouki Murakami, Sajuna Inui, Shinju Inui, Chitose Amano, Suzuka Itou, Miyako Honda, Akira Ogata, Riho Aizawa, Hikaru Kikuchi, Manabu Hasegawa, Rinko Onoda, Rana Sasaki, Erika Mizuno, Hajime Usami

character.name: Wakana Gojo
character.personality: At the start of the series, Wakana was a withdrawn person in high school, having no friends and a secret love and admiration for hina dolls. This stems from his past where a girl angrily told him that boys shouldn’t like dolls and called him a freak, something that clearly affected him very deeply to the point where he closed himself off from everyone and lived his high school life as a recluse. Wakana notes Marin Kitagawa and how she has her own interests in anime and the like, but unlike him, is free to be completely open with them and has many friends. His solitary attitude makes him rather submissive with others, claiming that he doesn’t mind his classmates leaving him to do after class clean up, although Marin correctly pointed out that they were taking advantage of him.

anime.name: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo suru
anime.quote: I've only ever used the word "pretty" for very special things. It's sort of like I can't say it unless I really, truly feel it.

relationships.friend: Nobara Aoyagi, Sajuna Inui, Shinju Inui, Akira Ogata, Takeru Koga, Kensei Morita, Shiki Kashiwagi, Kouki Murakami, Nowa Sugaya, Daia Yahiro, Rune Yamauchi, Seira Kasai, Karen Otsuka, Hajime Usami, Chitose Amano, Suzuka Itou, Miyako Honda

character.name: Nichika Gojo
character.personality: Seeing her attitude towards giving her grandfather a present, she seems to have inherited shy and nervous behaviors from her father. Even her mother punctualize this trait.

anime.name: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo suru
